0022600215.text: The Orlando Magic (2-6, 0-4 at home, on a three-game losing streak) are on the road against the Sacramento Kings (1-8, 0-4 at home, on a two-game losing streak), with Orlando 12th in the East and Sacramento 15th in the West. Orlando is without Desmond Bane (illness), Izaiyah Nelson (ankle, surgery), Jalen Suggs (knee), Jonathan Isaac (knee), Noah Penda (hamstring strain), and Paolo Banchero (ankle sprain), while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery) and Maxime Raynaud (dislocated knee). The Magic won both meetings in the 2025-26 season, including a 121-117 win in Orlando on March 26, 2026, and the teams have not yet played each other this season.
